summary: Enhance your skills with our Business Continuity Planning (BCP) Training Course. Learn to prepare for disruptions and ensure organizational resilience.
lede: Business continuity planning (BCP) helps professionals identify critical functions, assess disruption impacts and prepare recovery arrangements. This course is for continuity, risk, operations and IT service continuity professionals who need to maintain plans and coordinate recovery. It covers business impact analysis, recovery objectives and supplier dependencies, alongside risk registers, communication planning and tabletop exercises to test and improve readiness.
audienceIntro: This Business Continuity Planning course is designed for professionals who need to assess disruption exposure, build continuity responses, and support operational recovery across critical functions.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with operational processes, risk terminology, and basic organizational reporting structures. Prior experience with ISO 22301, business impact analysis, or crisis management is helpful but not required; the course introduces the core methods in a practical way and moves toward applied continuity planning. No coding or programming is required. You will benefit most if you can bring a laptop, a sample process map, or a current continuity document for workshop use.
